description: Membongkar teks QRIS menjadi field bernama. Decodes a QRIS / EMVCo merchant-presented QR payload into named fields: static or dynamic, merchant accounts (tags 26-51, incl. NMID in the national QRIS template), MCC, currency, amount, tip/fee, country, merchant name/city, postal code, additional data (tag 62), language template and the CRC check. Offline, nothing is sent anywhere.

qris.description: The QRIS payload text (starts with "000201" and ends with "6304" + 4 hex characters). Paste text, not an image.

name: parse_qris
title: Baca QRIS / Parse QRIS
